FenixAdvancedTargeting.name: Advanced Targeting
FenixAdvancedTargeting.description: Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Plasma Cutter permanently increases Fenix's Basic Attack damage by 0.5, up to 60. Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Plasma Cutter circles an additional time.

FenixArsenalSynergy.name: Arsenal Synergy
FenixArsenalSynergy.description: After hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks 3 times while Repeater Cannon is active, the next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb deals 150% more damage and splashes in a 50% larger area.

FenixMobileOffense.name: Mobile Offense
FenixMobileOffense.description: After moving, Fenix's next Basic Attack deals 35% more damage to Heroes.

FenixTargetAcquired.name: Target Acquired
FenixTargetAcquired.description: Basic Attacks against Slowed Heroes with Repeater Cannon active grant 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

FenixInhibitingEnergy.name: Inhibiting Energy
FenixInhibitingEnergy.description: Every 10 seconds, Fenix's next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb active Slows all enemies hit by 60%, decaying in strength over 1.5 seconds.

FenixEmergencyProtocol.name: Emergency Protocol
FenixEmergencyProtocol.description: While Fenix has shields from Shield Capacitor, he gains 10% Movement Speed. This bonus is increased to 15% when Fenix loses shields from Shield Capacitor.

FenixCombatAdvantage.name: Combat Advantage
FenixCombatAdvantage.description: Plasma Cutter deals 35% more damage to Slowed targets.

FenixWarpWarfare.name: Warp Warfare
FenixWarpWarfare.description: After arriving with Warp, gain 175% Attack Speed for 4 seconds while in Repeater Cannon mode. Hero Takedowns reset Warp's cooldown.

FenixDivertPowerWeaponsTalent.name: Divert Power: Weapons
FenixDivertPowerWeaponsTalent.description: Activate to gain 40% Basic Attack damage for 5 seconds. Basic Attacking a Hero refreshes this duration. Once Divert Power: Weapons ends, drain all of Shield Capacitor's Shields.

FenixHeroicAbilityPurificationSalvo.name: Purification Salvo
FenixHeroicAbilityPurificationSalvo.description: Channel for 1.5 seconds, sweeping a laser in front of Fenix that locks onto enemy Heroes. Once Channeling finishes, fire 5 missiles at each locked Hero, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage each. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

FenixHeroicAbilityPlanetCracker.name: Planet Cracker
FenixHeroicAbilityPlanetCracker.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel a powerful beam that spans across the battleground for 4 seconds, dealing 112 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to non-Structure enemies hit.

FenixAdaniumShell.name: Adanium Shell
FenixAdaniumShell.description: After arriving with Warp, gain 50 Armor for 4 seconds.

FenixDampeningField.name: Dampening Field
FenixDampeningField.description: Fenix gains 30 Spell Armor while he has a Shield from Shield Capacitor.

FenixRapidRecharge.name: Rapid Recharge
FenixRapidRecharge.description: The time before Shield Capacitor begins regenerating after taking damage is reduced by 2 seconds. Whenever Fenix is healed, Shield Capacitor's Shield recharges for 60% of the healing received.

FenixAuxiliaryShields.name: Auxiliary Shields
FenixAuxiliaryShields.description: Permanently reduce Fenix's maximum Health by 30% but increase Shield Capacitor's Shield by 40%. Basic Attacks regenerate Shields equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

FenixOffensiveCadence.name: Offensive Cadence
FenixOffensiveCadence.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against Heroes while Repeater Cannon is active deals an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health as damage.

FenixPhotonicWeaponry.name: Photonic Weaponry
FenixPhotonicWeaponry.description: Fenix deals 20% more damage while he has a Shield from Shield Capacitor.

FenixArsenalOvercharge.name: Arsenal Overcharge
FenixArsenalOvercharge.description: Basic Attacks with Repeater Cannon reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds. Basic Attacks with Phase Bomb active reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds per Hero hit.

FenixArmageddonBeam.name: Armageddon Beam
FenixArmageddonBeam.description: Planet Cracker's width increases by 100% over 1.5 seconds. Passive: Reduce Planet Cracker's cooldown by 40 seconds.

FenixSecondaryFire.name: Secondary Fire
FenixSecondaryFire.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plasma Cutter fires a Purification Salvo missile at them after 0.5 seconds, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

FenixSingularityCharge.name: Singularity Charge
FenixSingularityCharge.description: Repeater Cannon grants 100% more Attack Speed, and Phase Bomb grants 1.25 more range.

FenixUnconqueredSpirit.name: Unconquered Spirit
FenixUnconqueredSpirit.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Shield Capacitor regains 800 (+4% per level) Shields. This effect has a 120 second cooldown.
